audience: maintenance managers and plant engineers who run work orders and assets in Fiix

useCases.title: Count open work orders for a site
useCases.text: Count the work orders that match a Fiix QL filter, such as the open orders of one site. The reply holds only the total.

useCases.title: List purchase orders from one supplier
useCases.text: Find purchase orders with a Fiix QL filter for one supplier, and read only the fields you name.

useCases.title: Review assets and their details
useCases.text: Find assets with a Fiix QL filter, then read one asset by its numeric id to check its details.

useCases.title: Look up one work order by id
useCases.text: Read one work order by its numeric id, with the fields you name.
